name: Unidentified B2-series super battle droid (Gabredor III)
wookieepedia_title: Unidentified B2-series super battle droid (Gabredor III)
description: A B2-series super battle droid served in governor Tauntaza's secret base on the planet Gabredor III. The droid was destroyed by Ochi of Bestoon when Sabé and Darth Vader lead an attacked the base.

data.name: Unidentified B2-series super battle droid
data.death: Between 3 ABY and 4 ABY, Gabredor III
